scope: The original M_CLI FPM library is unchanged. The checked consumer adapts the author example/demo3.f90, translating a prototype command into NAMELIST text and checking integer, real, logical, character and three-element real array defaults before using the scaled sum. No stdin or program arguments are required; the editable prototype supplies the defaults. Actual command-line overrides, help/error paths and interactive examples are not runtime-verified here. N1/N3 cover command input and character parsing; no numerical-method classification is inferred. Public-domain/Unlicense notices are retained.
